_note: All text players see for rp_jobmoments. Edit the words on the right side only. Keep every %s: the game fills those in (names, amounts, streets). \n starts a new line.
title: On the job

bloody_bag.title: Something's wrong with this bag
bloody_bag.story: The bag splits open as you lift it. Inside: a pistol and a shirt soaked in dried blood. Nobody's around.

lost_wallet.title: A wallet in the trash
lost_wallet.story: A wallet, tossed in with the garbage. The ID says %s, with a home address. There's $%s inside.

left_bag.title: Left on the back seat
left_bag.story: Your passenger is gone, but their gym bag isn't. You unzip it: about $%s in cash, rubber-banded.

bloody_bag.turn_in_desc: Take it to a police front desk (Mission Row or Paleto). There's a reward.
bloody_bag.keep_desc: Nobody saw. Nobody needs to know... right?

lost_wallet.return_desc: Your GPS will show their address. They might be grateful.

left_bag.turn_in: Turn it in to the police
left_bag.turn_in_desc: Take it to a police front desk. There's a reward.
left_bag.keep_desc: $%s in loose bills. They'd have to be laundered before you could spend them safely.
left_bag.leave: Zip it back up and leave it
left_bag.leave_desc: Someone else can deal with it.

bloody_bag.turn_in: You bag the pistol and the shirt. Take them to a police front desk (use the item to set your GPS).
bloody_bag.keep: You tuck the pistol away. Its serial number is still on file somewhere...
bloody_bag.leave: You toss the bag back and move on. It stays with you, though.

lost_wallet.return: You pocket the wallet. Your GPS is set to the owner's address.
lost_wallet.take_cash: You take the cash and toss the wallet.
lost_wallet.leave: You leave the wallet where it was.

left_bag.turn_in: You take the bag. Bring it to a police front desk (use the item to set your GPS).
left_bag.keep: You stash the cash. Hopefully nobody wrote down your cab's plate.
left_bag.leave: You zip the bag back up and leave it.

runner.start: Hey! Your passenger just bolted without paying! You have %s seconds to catch them.
runner.help: [E] Grab them  ·  [G] Call it in to police
runner.caught: You grab them. Embarrassed, they pay up with a tip: $%s.
runner.reported: You call it in. Police have the description. The fare is gone, though.
runner.dead: They're not getting up. That's not how you collect a fare...
runner.escaped: They're gone. So is your fare.

desk.thanks: The desk officer logs %s item(s) and hands you a $%s reward. "Thanks for doing the right thing."
desk.gps: GPS set to the nearest police front desk.

wallet.thanks: %s can't believe it. "Thank you so much!" They give you $%s.
wallet.gps: GPS set to the owner's address: %s.

item.bloody_bag: A pistol (serial %s) and a bloody shirt, found in the trash near %s. Turn it in at a police front desk.
item.wallet: Belongs to %s. Use it to set your GPS to their address.
item.left_bag: Gym bag with $%s in cash, left in taxi %s. Turn it in at a police front desk.

alert.runner: Taxi fare skipped: suspect fled on foot

detail.shooting:
Shots fired near %s. The victim was treated and released. The weapon, a pistol (serial %s), was never found.

The shooter is unknown. Carrying this weapon doesn't prove who fired it. Ask where they got it.
detail.lost_cash: A passenger reports leaving about $%s in a gym bag in taxi %s, near %s.
detail.fare_evasion: A $%s taxi fare skipped near %s. The suspect fled on foot. Reported by driver %s (taxi %s).
detail.pedestrian_down: A pedestrian was found dead near %s. Witnesses saw them running from a taxi (plate %s).

cases.title: Case files
cases.staff_only: Only staff can see this. Citizen ID: %s

serial.match: Serial %s is linked to case #%s (%s): %s. The shooter is unknown. Carrying this weapon doesn't prove who fired it. Ask where they got it. Use /cases for details.

command.cases_help: Police (on duty) and staff: open the case files
command.serial_help: Police (on duty) and staff: check a weapon serial number against the case files
command.serial_param: The serial number from the weapon

error.cant_carry: You can't carry that. Make some room and pick again.
error.nothing: You don't have any found evidence.
error.no_permission: Only on-duty police and staff can do that.
